protocol_profile: HTTP/2 cleartext (h2c), direct preface mode, over TCP
aflnet_adaptation: Custom HTTP2 request-frame and response-frame-state parser in patches/aflnet-http2.patch; parser combines the client preface with a valid initial SETTINGS frame, then splits complete later frames by the 24-bit payload length and keeps malformed trailing bytes intact. Response feedback records frame type and flags; it does not decode HPACK status codes. An additional lifecycle patch removes AFLNet's busy wait after -K, drains 100 ms for protocol worker completion, and retries interrupted waitpid calls. Apache uses the standard AFL forkserver, which initializes before server startup so each testcase gets a fresh AFL-instrumented single-process prefork httpd -DFOREGROUND -X child; -K sends SIGTERM and the forkserver reaps it, without a wrapper or skipped instrumentation check.
